lessons.title: Character Nuances & Self-Identity
lessons.teacher_notes: Analyze character nuances, temperament, first impressions, and register control (reliable vs dependable).

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous vs Simple
lessons.teacher_notes: Compare action duration ('have been studying for 3 hours') vs completed results ('have read 3 chapters').

lessons.title: Wellbeing, Stress & Resilience
lessons.teacher_notes: Discuss coping mechanisms, preventing burnout, work-life balance, and emotional resilience.

lessons.title: Employment, Applications & Recruitment
lessons.teacher_notes: Focus on job recruitment, tailoring CVs, professional cover letters, and salary negotiations.

lessons.title: Past Perfect Simple & Continuous
lessons.teacher_notes: Contrast past actions completed prior to another past event vs ongoing background past activities.

lessons.title: Project Management & Team Dynamics
lessons.teacher_notes: Discuss meeting tight deadlines, resolving bottlenecks, handling complaints, and team collaboration.

lessons.title: News Media, Objectivity & Bias
lessons.teacher_notes: Analyze news consumption, identifying fake news, fact-checking, and sensational reporting.

lessons.title: Causative Structures (Have/Get Done)
lessons.teacher_notes: Practice arranging professional services ('having my car fixed', 'getting the data encrypted').

lessons.title: Cybersecurity & Green Sustainability
lessons.teacher_notes: Debate digital privacy rights, cybersecurity practices, and environmental sustainability initiatives.

lessons.title: Personal Budgeting & Consumer Protection
lessons.teacher_notes: Cover personal finance budgeting, interest rates, avoiding online phishing scams, and consumer rights.

lessons.title: Second & Third Conditionals + Wishes
grammar: I wish + Past Simple / Past Perfect
lessons.teacher_notes: Express hypothetical present scenarios, past regrets ('If I had studied...'), and desires for change.

lessons.title: Academic Integrity & Civic Rights
lessons.teacher_notes: Discuss academic research ethics, avoiding plagiarism, volunteering, and promoting community equality.

lessons.title: Business Negotiations & Complaints
lessons.teacher_notes: Master formal complaints, handling client issues, polite disagreement, and negotiating trade-offs.

lessons.title: Modals of Deduction & Relative Clauses
lessons.teacher_notes: Practice present and past speculation ('must have been delayed') and cohesive relative clauses.

lessons.title: Presentations, Meetings & Public Speaking
vocabulary: Today I'd like to talk to you about...
lessons.teacher_notes: Deliver structured presentations, chair meetings, manage Q&A sessions, and switch register effectively.
